cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Sign up for the overnight shift if this project matters to you. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'm keeping myself available for leadership decisions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Apparently my test has reached a less comfortable definition of commitment.

mechanism: A leads an overnight commitment test but bargains down personal availability when B makes that test reciprocal.
confusable: Generic hypocrisy lacks a test A creates and a reply that exposes the specific sacrifice A will not make.
comparison: Seat alternative exposes comfort and status rather than a leader refusal to lose sleep.
seedUse: Overnight seed gives a reciprocal question; replace its self-diagnosing ending with an actual boundary A tries to negotiate.
